comment: The Haro v0.5 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.5 grows v0.4 by what an EXPRESSION language needs to be forged whole -- its court AND its evaluator -- from its declaration (haro/SPIKE.md, the fifth rung: stz's W, the alphabet's W letter, 29 fixtures): CONTEXTS on an EXPRESSION, naming the seats a host offers the expression and which of its VARIABLES each seat admits; a language that is only an EXPRESSION, with no DECLARATION, is a language, and the forge emits <lang>_expr.ring for it. Every v0.4 fixture still passes: v0.5 refuses nothing v0.4 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: CONTEXTS on an EXPRESSION: the seats the host offers the expression, each with the VARIABLES it admits; an empty list is a seat for constants
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [or, and, not, cmp, add, sub, mul, div, mod, neg], OPERANDS [number, text, var], VARIABLES [item, accumulator], CONTEXTS [eval: [], map: [item], reduce: [accumulator, item]]) RATIONALE "the seats fix the variables"

accepts.name: an EXPRESSION without CONTEXTS admits every VARIABLE in every seat, as v0.1 did
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [cmp, add], OPERANDS [number, var], VARIABLES [item]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.4 declaration is a v0.5 declaration: v0.4's A6, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE set AS (VERSION "0.4", GRAMMAR "0.4", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".set") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT key64 AS (SHAPE hex64, FOLD case, MESSAGE "KEY is 64 hex characters, and '{value}' is not one") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT head AS (SHAPE hex64_lower, MESSAGE "THROUGH is 64 lowercase hex, and '{value}' is not") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [link: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION member AS (VERB "MEMBER", SEATS [key: key64?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION retirement AS (VERB "RETIREMENT", SEATS [member: member, key: key64, through: head], MESSAGES [member: "RETIREMENT {name} retires a key of {value}, and no MEMBER {value} is declared", through: "RETIREMENT {name} names no THROUGH"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD set AS (ONE [group], FIRST group) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_key_one_member AS (ON member, WHEN "key present and not key unique", MESSAGE "this key is already {other}'s key") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT retired_once AS (ON retirement, WHEN "earlier retirement where key = this.key", MESSAGE "this key is already retired as {other}") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a CONTEXT admits VARIABLES of the expression, not names of its own
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, var], VARIABLES [item], CONTEXTS [map: [thing]]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: CONTEXTS requires VARIABLES, since a seat is a choice among them
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number], CONTEXTS [map: []]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a context is named once
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, var], VARIABLES [item], CONTEXTS [map: [item], map: [item]]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: the operator menu is still closed: an operator the menu lacks is unexpressible, not forbidden
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [cmp, call], OPERANDS [number]) RATIONALE "x"
